website.note: Page summarizes MEK-inhibitor focus areas (NF1, ALS, MS, schizophrenia) and references marketed selumetinib for context; PAS-004 is the only proprietary clinical-stage asset

pipeline.modality: Small molecule, macrocyclic allosteric MEK 1/2 inhibitor (oral capsule/tablet)

indications.indication: MAPK pathway-driven advanced solid tumors (RAS, NF1 or RAF mutations; or prior MAPK-pathway-targeted therapy)
indications.trial_name: First-in-human Phase 1 multicenter open-label dose-escalation in advanced solid tumors
indications.trial_design: Open-label, multicenter, dose-escalation; PK/PD, safety, RECIST 1.1; food-effect sub-study
indications.trial_status: Recruiting (started 2024-02-29; primary completion 2026-02; cohort 8 / 45 mg dosed as of Dec 2025)
key_milestones: Interim safety/PK/PD data Dec 2025 cutoff: well tolerated, t1/2 ~60h

indications.indication: Neurofibromatosis Type 1 (NF1) with symptomatic / inoperable plexiform neurofibromas (PNs)
indications.trial_name: Phase 1/1b dose-escalation of PAS-004 in adults with NF1-PN
indications.trial_design: Multicenter, open-label, dose-escalation; safety/tolerability, RPBD/MTD, REiNS criteria for tumor volume, QOL
key_milestones: Trial initiated May 2025 with Novotech (Australia) collaborator

excluded_preclinical.asset: MEK inhibitor research programs in ALS, MS, schizophrenia
excluded_preclinical.reason: Preclinical / discovery stage, not in active clinical trials
